source.detail: ⚠ Corrects a wrong auto-merge. This was folded into `the-family-office-ksa` — which is The Family Office International Investment Company (Saudi Arabia), an entirely different firm that merely shares the words 'family office'. Alajlan Family Office is the self-described single family office of the Alajlan family, investing in B2B SaaS, PropTech and EdTech across MENAP. ⚠ Also distinct from Ajlan & Bros Group, the family's operating conglomerate. Evidence: https://alajlanfamilyoffice.com/
